---
title: "Caption layout"
format: typst
filters:
  - index
---

The fixture for a mark in the caption of a float that Quarto lays out in
cells (M115 review). The filter moves a caption's labels into the content of a
float whose content is one block, so that a Typst list of figures does not copy
them. It leaves a float whose content is several blocks as it is, because each
change to that content changed Quarto's layout: a wrapper made two cells one,
and a label joined to an image's cell kept a width Quarto drops there. So the
two text cells below print side by side, on one line of text, and the two
images on the next page print at one size. Each mark files its own page.
